description: Player experience evaluation metrics for Super Mario Bros.-style maps.

experience_metrics.description: These items use a 5-point Likert scale (1: Strongly disagree ~ 5: Strongly agree)

metrics.name: fun
metrics.description: Enjoyment / Fun: a fundamental measure of how much the participant enjoyed the level, aligned with positive affect.

metrics.name: challenging
metrics.description: Difficulty / Challenge: measures the perceived challenge of the level, reflecting how difficult or easy it felt.

metrics.name: frustrating
metrics.survey_item: I felt frustrated while playing it.
metrics.description: Frustration / Negative Affect: captures negative experience when the level feels unfair, too difficult, unrewarding, or frustrating.

metrics.name: surprising
metrics.survey_item: It had surprises or unexpected elements.
metrics.description: Novelty / Surprise: measures how original, surprising, innovative, or unexpected the level felt.

metrics.name: design
metrics.survey_item: The layout felt well-designed and high-quality.
metrics.description: Aesthetics / Design Quality: asks the player to evaluate how well-designed and high-quality the layout and presentation felt.

perception_metrics.description: Measures the player's perception of the creator after completing the experience metrics.

metrics.name: creator_belief
metrics.survey_item: Who do you think made this level?

metrics.name: confidence_level
metrics.survey_item: How confident are you in your choice?

qualitative_reasoning.description: Open-ended question to understand the reasoning behind the numerical data.

metrics.name: reasoning_for_creator_belief
metrics.survey_item: What did you base your decision on? What signs or indicators guided your decision?
